# Source of the files in this directory

Every file here is copied verbatim from the upstream repository
`synadia-ai/synadia-agents`, directory `test-fixtures/identity/`, at commit
`a1bfb47`. The one exception is this file.

| File here | Upstream path |
| --- | --- |
| `sender-vectors.json` | `test-fixtures/identity/sender-vectors.json` |
| `id-sig-vectors.json` | `test-fixtures/identity/id-sig-vectors.json` |
| `agent-id-fixtures.json` | `test-fixtures/identity/agent-id-fixtures.json` |
| `keys.json` | `test-fixtures/identity/keys.json` |
| `accounts.conf` | `test-fixtures/identity/accounts.conf` |
| `account-token-position.conf` | `test-fixtures/identity/account-token-position.conf` |
| `closed-import.conf` | `test-fixtures/identity/closed-import.conf` |
| `nkey-deny-sys.conf` | `test-fixtures/identity/nkey-deny-sys.conf` |
| `nkey-noaccounts.conf` | `test-fixtures/identity/nkey-noaccounts.conf` |
| `operator/operator.conf` | `test-fixtures/identity/operator/operator.conf` |
| `operator/alice.creds` | `test-fixtures/identity/operator/alice.creds` |
| `operator/bob.creds` | `test-fixtures/identity/operator/bob.creds` |
| `operator/carol.creds` | `test-fixtures/identity/operator/carol.creds` |
| `operator/keys.json` | `test-fixtures/identity/operator/keys.json` |

The vectors are known-answer vectors generated by upstream's TypeScript
implementation and verified by every upstream SDK. They are run by
`vectors_test.go` in the parent directory (`TestVectors_SenderVectors`,
`TestVectors_IDSigVectors`, `TestVectors_AgentIDFixtures`,
`TestVectors_KeysDeriveTheirPublicKeys`). The `.conf` files and the operator
credentials drive the embedded-server tests in `test/identity/`.

All keys and credentials here are throwaway, test-only material that
authenticates nothing outside a test process. Never reuse them. Do not edit
these files: to update them, copy the upstream files again at a new commit and
change the commit named above.
